summary: United Fire Group Inc. filed an 8-K furnishing a press release that announces the date of its first-quarter 2026 earnings release (May 5, 2026, after market close) and the subsequent earnings conference call (May 6, 2026). No special-situation event — such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change — is described. The filing is a routine earnings-schedule announcement furnished under Item 8.01 and does not contain any material definitive agreement or corporate action that would qualify as a special situation.
